capabilities: View week, month, year, and century calendars with note indicators
Create and open daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, yearly, decadal, and century notes
Display, complete, and reschedule dated checkbox tasks on the calendar
Show regional holidays and Chinese lunar, Persian, Hebrew, and other calendar extensions
Create time-range notes by dragging date ranges or setting start and end properties
disambiguation: Not a time-tracking or timestamp tool; it is a calendar workspace for periodic notes and date-based features.
extras: ICS support is local and read-only only; RRULE/RDATE recurring events are skipped and reported rather than expanded, so recurrence-heavy calendars may look incomplete. Requires Obsidian 1.12.7+. Keeps a rebuildable note index in device IndexedDB outside the vault; no account or uploads.
problem: Obsidian's built-in calendar support is limited to daily notes, with no multi-period notes, task display, holidays, non-Gregorian calendars, or date-range notes on a calendar view.

relations.evidence: periodic notes with built-in or Templater templates

summary: Calendar workspace plugin that shows daily through century periodic notes on week, month, year, and century views with tasks, holidays, and ICS events.
